warnings.problem: The one Custom-tier fit_gap row (the record-page panel, steps M3-S03/M3-S04/M3-S05) carries no `recommended_agents`, and `skills/admin/fit-gap-analysis-against-org/scripts/check_fit_gap_analysis_against_org.py:14` states rule 4: 'Every Custom row has a non-empty recommended_agents'. The same skill's quality checklist (SKILL.md:207) also asks that AppExchange alternatives be searched for any Custom or Unfit row unless customer policy excludes managed packages; neither is recorded, and no fit_gap `note` says the build layer drops the field deliberately.
warnings.fix: Either add `recommended_agents` to that row (apex-builder, lwc-builder, metadata-builder - the three owners the steps already name), or add one clause to the row's `note` saying the build layer carries the handoff on `step.agent` instead. Warning rather than blocker on three grounds: all 14 rows carry the tier, the `effort` tier and a `risk_tag` array, which is the mandatory-field test this agent's own playbook states; `build-plan.schema.json` requires none of the three so `validate` is silent; and no artefact any step produces changes either way - the agent handoff is already on `step.agent` and was confirmed by the executability lens on all three steps.

warnings.problem: Round 1's PV-W07 is carried forward unchanged and correctly declined. `inputs.process_definition_name` is still not a key `agents/apex-builder/AGENT.md`'s Inputs table defines. It supplies rather than withholds (the exact developer name 'Discount_Approval' that check_approval_process_apex_patterns.py resolves), and unlike `metadata-builder` that agent's contract carries no 'Nothing else is accepted' clause, so nothing refuses on it.
warnings.fix: None required, as round 1 itself recorded. A `process_definition_name` input in apex-builder's table would make the mapping explicit if that agent is next revised.
